priorityList: Summon your pet before combat if you have the Unbreakable Bond talent.
Use offensive racial abilities and combat potions while Trueshot is active to maximize burst damage.
Sync on-use trinkets with Trueshot, especially the Algethar Puzzle Box if equipped.
Cast Multi-Shot if the Trick Shots buff is missing or to spend Precise Shots stacks, prioritizing targets without Sentinel's Mark to spread the debuff.
Cast Volley on cooldown to trigger the Trick Shots effect.
Cast Aimed Shot while Trick Shots is active, prioritizing targets already afflicted by Sentinel's Mark.
Cast Rapid Fire while Trick Shots is active, or use it to prevent the Bulletstorm buff from expiring.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus when no other abilities are available.
